welcomeSuggestions: How do I book an appointment?

faqs.answer: HealthCare is a modern healthcare platform offering a complete range of medical services. You can browse and book appointments with board-certified specialists, explore our services (cardiology, neurology, orthopedics, dermatology, pediatrics and more), book video consultations, order home sample collection, and manage everything through your patient portal. We have three facilities across the city plus 24/7 emergency care.

Patients choose HealthCare because of:
- Board-certified specialists with 10–20+ years of experience
- Advanced, modern diagnostic and treatment technology
- 24/7 emergency and urgent care availability
- Transparent, affordable pricing with flexible payment options
- Personalized treatment plans and dedicated follow-ups
- Accredited facilities with nationally recognized quality standards

questions: What time does the clinic open?
faqs.answer:
Our working hours are:
- Emergency Care: 24/7 / 365 days
- Outpatient consultations: Monday to Friday, 8 AM – 8 PM
- Weekends: Saturday, 9 AM – 5 PM
Sunday is closed for outpatient services, but the emergency department stays open around the clock.

questions: Can I visit without an appointment?
faqs.answer: Yes! Walk-ins are welcome. If you arrive without an appointment, our team will fit you in as soon as possible. For emergencies, no appointment is needed at all — we triage and stabilize patients immediately.

questions: Can I use my health insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes, we accept major health insurance plans. You can also pay securely by card and UPI. During checkout you can choose your preferred payment method, and our billing team can help you with insurance claims. For the smoothest experience, please carry your insurance card details when you visit.

questions: How do I book an appointment?
How can I schedule a visit?
faqs.answer:
Booking an appointment is simple:
1. Go to the Doctors page.
2. Browse specialists and pick the doctor you'd like to see.
3. Click 'Book Appointment' and fill in your name, phone and email.
4. Choose an available date and time slot.
5. Confirm — and you'll receive a confirmation with all your details.
Video consultations and home sample collection can also be booked directly from their pages.

questions: What should I do in a medical emergency?
faqs.answer:
If you're experiencing a medical emergency, call 911 immediately. Dial 911 or visit our 24/7 emergency department as soon as possible for:
- Chest pain, pressure or difficulty breathing
- Severe bleeding or deep injuries
- Loss of consciousness or fainting
- Sudden weakness, numbness or stroke symptoms
- Severe allergic reactions or trouble swallowing
- Seizures, choking or poisoning
Our ER is open 24/7/365 and walk-ins are always accepted.

questions: Can I see a doctor online?
faqs.answer:
Yes! Video consultation lets you see a doctor from anywhere:
1. Choose your verified doctor.
2. Pick a convenient time slot (including evenings and weekends).

4. Get your e-prescription and follow-up plan instantly afterwards.

questions: What do I need for a video consultation?

faqs.answer: You only need a stable internet connection and a device with a camera and microphone — phone, tablet or laptop. Everything runs in your browser, optimized for any screen. No app download is required.

questions: Is the video consultation secured and private?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Every video session is end-to-end encrypted, so your consultation stays completely confidential. We follow strict medical privacy standards, verify every doctor, and never share your session or health data.

questions: Do I get a prescription after a video consultation?
faqs.answer: Yes. You receive a digital prescription and medical notes instantly after your consultation. You'll also get a clear follow-up plan, so you always know your next steps. Everything is saved to your patient record.

questions: Can I get a blood test done at home?
faqs.answer:
Yes! Our home sample collection brings diagnostic testing to your doorstep:
1. Book a slot online or over the phone.
2. A certified phlebotomist visits your home with sterile, single-use equipment.
3. Samples are collected hygienically under strict protocols.
4. Analysis happens in our NABL-accredited lab.
5. Accurate digital reports are delivered to your phone and email in 24–48 hours.
Service includes 120+ blood tests, hormone tests, PCR and more.
